dct_title_s: United Arab Emirates - Subnational Edge-matched Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: United Arab Emirates administrative level 0-1 edge-matched gazetteer, shapefiles, and geodatabase. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [United Arab Emirates - Subnational Administrative Boundaries COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-are); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. There is no United Arab Emirates population statistics COD-PS. Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID.
dct_publisher_sm: Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre, UAE Ministry of Cabinet Affairs and ITOS
